description: Deterministic selection rules. The code in tools/visual_overhaul/selection/rules.py implements exactly these tables; validate_selection.py re-derives every decision from them.
decision_order: R1 no_independent_evidence: independent member share < min_independent_share -> not_selected
R3 class technique/reference or conversion not_portable -> reference_only(policy_reference_class)

R4 class control: relation identical/content_match_native -> not_selected(identical_to_native); other relation -> reference_only(control_differs_from_native); unmeasured -> reference_only(needs_evidence)
R5 class direct/convertible: gain 0 -> not_selected(identical_to_native); gain unmeasured -> reference_only(needs_evidence)

R6 direct/convertible: compat >= preferred_min_compat, risk <= preferred_max_risk, gain >= preferred_min_gain -> eligible_preferred; compat >= alternate_min_compat and gain >= alternate_min_gain -> eligible_alternate; else reference_only(below_integration_thresholds)
R7 per target: best eligible_preferred by ranking key becomes preferred; remaining eligible_preferred and eligible_alternate become alternate
R8 targets with no preferred resolve to platinum_native
